messages:
sam: dropped a short brief: thinking about breadcrumb semantics when the console shows permission-gated resources. e.g., user A can see Model meta but not Versions. how should breadcrumbs behave for clarity + routing?

anya: interesting. two options: 1) show the full breadcrumb but grey out inaccessible crumbs with a tooltip 'restricted'. 2) collapse inaccessible parents and show a hint 'parent hidden'. i prefer #1 for predictability

leo: agree on predictability. important for runbooks: external links should remain stable. suggest canonical paths include the full ancestry even if user lacks perms, but client hides links and shows accessible label + tooltip explaining restriction

faye: accessibility note: if a crumb is present but disabled, it still needs to be keyboard-focusable so screenreader can read the tooltip. but it shouldn't be clickable. add aria-disabled and an explanatory aria-describedby pointing to the reason

omar: routing: canonical route format proposal: /models/:id(/versions/:vid)(/sub). even if versions are hidden for some users, the URL should still include them when linking from external sources to preserve anchors. client can 302 to accessible view when necessary

i18n-bot: remind: breadcrumb text must be localizable. avoid concatenated strings like 'Model • Foo' in code. use i18n keys for patterning and interpolate resource type + name separately

sam: UX for collapsed breadcrumb: when parent is hidden, show 'Model • Foo' and a small muted pill 'Parent hidden' that is keyboard-focusable and has a tooltip 'You don't have permission to view the parent resource'

anya: mobile / responsive detail: breadcrumbs may not fit. collapse to a single line with ellipsis and a dropdown that lists the full trail. deep links should still be copyable from the share menu and include full path (even collapsed on mobile)

leo: copy suggestions for restricted tooltip: 'This parent resource is restricted. Contact your org admin to request access.' keep short. for admin-facing views show a 'Request access' CTA that opens an email composer or support flow

faye: a11y for dropdown: if breadcrumb collapses into a dropdown, ensure it opens on Enter and Arrow keys, announce via aria-expanded, and focus goes to the first crumb in the list. also ensure reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion when expanding the dropdown

omar: analytics note: capture crumb_visibility: full|collapsed|restricted and link_source: breadcrumb|share|api so we can measure if restricted crumbs cause confusion or support tickets

i18n-bot: pluralization reminder: resource types may pluralize differently in other languages. use explicit keys for singular/plural variants in breadcrumb templates

sam: deep-link behaviour: when external link contains a hidden parent path, client should attempt to fetch resource metadata. if response 403 -> render current resource with restricted pill and do not redirect away. do not expose hidden parent's metadata in client UI, only show placeholder crumb

anya: back-button nuance: if a user navigates via a deep link that includes a parent and we replace history with a restricted view, we should add a replaceState instead of pushState to avoid confusing back navigation. document in RFC

leo: breadcrumbs + back nav for multi-tab: if user opens a deep link in new tab, ensure focus management is correct: focus H1 and do not auto-open any dropdowns. users expect stable landing context

faye: keyboard shortcut idea: provide 'g then b' to jump to breadcrumbs. announce shortcut in help modal. ensure the shortcut works even when the breadcrumb is collapsed into dropdown by opening it and focusing first item

omar: routing alias note: keep legacy routes as aliases with server-side redirects for 9 months. log deprecation and send events on first resolve per-org so support can reach out to heavy users of old routes

i18n-bot: UI copy for pill: 'Parent hidden'. localized suggestion examples: es: 'Elemento padre oculto', fr: 'Parent masqué' (use exact translation flow in PO files)

sam: summary of action items: - RFC: canonical route pattern + alias policy (omar) - Accessibility checklist: aria-disabled, aria-describedby, focus management, reduced-motion (faye) - i18n keys for breadcrumb templates and pills (i18n-bot) - Analytics: crumb_visibility + link_source + alias_resolves (leo) - Copy drafts for tooltips & request access flows (anya)

anya: i'll draft tooltip microcopy and a tiny mock for mobile collapsed crumbs. will include admin CTA variants.

leo: i'll add analytics schema to the routing RFC and examples of alias lifecycles.

faye: i'll run an a11y pass on the prototype once anya posts mocks. will add tests for screenreader announcement and reduced-motion handling

omar: i'll sketch redirect behaviour and ensure deep-link landing rules: fetch primary resource, show placeholder for hidden parent, replaceState on load to keep history tidy.

sam: great, let's reconvene after mocks. thanks all :sparkles:
